about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV6 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport TDV6 has been a key part of the model line-up since 2005, spanning two generations of the vehicle. The earlier L320 generation (2005–2013) and the later L494 (2013–2022) both use the 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, offered in both TDV6 and SDV6 forms. The SDV6 is a higher-output variant of the same engine family, but both share the same core architecture and known wear patterns. Knowing which one your car has matters for exact parts matching, which is why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting. Range Rover Sport Engine Codes TDV6 (L320, L494) A 3.0-litre V6 diesel fitted to the Range Rover Sport from 2005 to 2022 across two generations. Known for timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks, and crankshaft bearing wear over time — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild. Check Your TDV6 Range Rover Sport → [link to quote form] SDV6 (L320, L494) A higher-output version of the same 3.0-litre V6 diesel, also fitted from 2005 to 2022. Shares the same known issues as the TDV6, including timing chain tensioner wear and injector seal leaks. We apply the same component replacement as standard on every SDV6 rebuild. Check Your SDV6 Range Rover Sport → [link to quote form] Range Rover Sport Engine Compatibility Because the TDV6 and SDV6 are variants of the same engine family, fitting the correct replacement or ensuring the right parts are used is critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: Your exact engine code (TDV6 or SDV6) via registration or VIN Your generation (L320 or L494) Drivetrain and ancillary specification Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Range Rover Sport quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. We also cover: [Range Rover Sport SDV6 Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport TDV8 Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport SDV8 Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport HSE Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport Autobiography Dynamic Engine →] · [Range Rover Sport SVR Engine →] [← View All Land Rover Range Rover Sport Engines] Frequently Asked Questions What engine does the Land Rover Range Rover Sport TDV6 use? The TDV6 uses a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, which was fitted across two generations of the Range Rover Sport: the L320 (2005–2013) and the L494 (2013–2022). The SDV6 is a higher-output variant of the same engine family. How much does a Range Rover Sport TDV6 engine rebuild cost? Rebuilds start from £2,400 for both the TDV6 and SDV6. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Range Rover Sport? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the TDV6 or SDV6 before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild TDV6 Range Rover Sport engines? Yes. We replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 rebuild. Do you rebuild SDV6 Range Rover Sport engines? Yes. The SDV6 shares the same core architecture and wear patterns as the TDV6, and we service it to the same high standard. Do you supply used Range Rover Sport engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Range Rover Sport if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Range Rover Sport engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Sport TDV6 from 2023 to present. The TDV6 & SDV6 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older TDV6 & SDV6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every TDV6 & SDV6 rebuild.
